scoring_justification: Recomputing the tight-binding model from raw artifacts is prohibitive in the checker environment; result-level comparison with paper-reported gold and structural checks on wavefunction localization are the strongest feasible verification.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for critical_expansion.json (Δd_c/d₀ and ΔV_c/V₀)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Figure 5 and main text: Δd_c/d₀ = 0.34%, ΔV_c/V₀ = −0.68%
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's reported result for bulk L-point band inversion.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's actual published numbers used to define the critical expansion; they are reproduced here as the hidden comparison target.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Figure 2 and discussion: for Δd<Δd_c wavefunction resides on both surfaces (probability > 0.1); for Δd>Δd_c it shifts below the relaxed surface (probability on relaxed side < 0.01, opposite side > 0.1).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Inferred from the qualitative description in Figure 2 and the text; numeric thresholds are set to enforce the reported spatial redistribution.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These structural relations directly verify the topological blocking effect described in the paper, not arbitrary numbers.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for spatial_spectrum.json blocking ratio
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Figure 4 and caption: blocking ratio = 0.49 for 100-BL film, unrelaxed peak weight normalized to 1.0.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Taken from the paper's reported blocking ratio and the normalization they used.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the explicit numbers the paper provides to quantify the suppression of surface-state intensity.

outputs.description: Critical normalized expansion and corresponding fractional hopping change at L-point band inversion.
Probability distribution of surface states for two expansion values, showing migration away from the relaxed surface for Δd > Δd_c.
Blocking ratio and surface spectral weights quantifying the suppression of surface-state intensity by the relaxation layer.

output_contract.notes: All three artifacts are produced by tight-binding calculations using public parameters. The DFT structural optimization stage is omitted (proprietary code) and the task focuses exclusively on the tight-binding part that demonstrates the topological blocking effect.
